result.keptPassword: This person already has a staff password and keeps using it.

login.title: Platform console
login.subtitle: For Konnyaku operators. Every action is recorded in the audit log.
login.codeHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password…).
login.enrollHint: Platform accounts require two-step verification. Scan the QR code with an authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
login.qrAlt: QR code to add the account to an authenticator app
login.recoveryBody: Use one of these codes if you lose your phone. Each works once and they will not be shown again — keep them somewhere safe (a password manager).

tenants.title: Centers
tenants.description: Every center on the platform, its status and size.
tenants.createHint: Creates the center with its first administrator. The temporary password is shown once — send it to the administrator over a secure channel.
tenants.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 3–40 characters. Address: {example}
tenants.name: Center name
tenants.locales: Interface languages enabled for the center
tenants.timeZoneHint: IANA time zone name, for example Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh.
tenants.summary: {total, plural, one {# center} other {# centers}} · {suspended, plural, =0 {none suspended} other {# suspended}}

tenant.hostsHint: The center's site is served on these addresses. A custom domain needs a DNS record (A/CNAME) pointing to the server; the HTTPS certificate is issued automatically on first visit.
tenant.suspendHint: While suspended nobody can sign in, every request of the center is refused and the public site shows a notice. Data is kept.
tenant.resumeHint: The center works again at once; users sign in as usual.
tenant.addAdminHint: Grants center administration to a person (for example when the previous administrator left). Someone without a staff account gets a temporary password.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Who did what, when, and to which center. Entries are append-only: they cannot be edited or deleted.

operators.title: Operators
operators.description: Konnyaku staff who may use the platform console. One account per person, two-step verification required.
operators.inviteHint: The invited person signs in with the temporary password, turns on two-step verification the first time, then sets a new password.

account.title: Account
account.mustChange: You are using a temporary password. Set a new one to use the console.
account.recoveryLeft: {count, plural, =0 {All recovery codes are used — ask another operator to reset them.} one {# recovery code left.} other {# recovery codes left.}}

suspended.title: This center is temporarily unavailable
suspended.body: The site of {name} is suspended on Konnyaku. Students and parents, please contact the center directly.

errors.platform_invalid_credentials: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.platform_account_locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
errors.platform_invalid_code: The code is wrong or was already used. Wait for a new code and try again.
errors.platform_challenge_expired: The verification step expired. Sign in again.
errors.platform_password_too_short: The password must be at least 12 characters.
errors.platform_password_unchanged: The new password must differ from the old one.
errors.platform_password_change_required: Set a new password before continuing.
errors.platform_operator_email_taken: This email is already an operator.
errors.platform_operator_cannot_disable_self: You cannot disable your own account.
errors.platform_slug_invalid: The center code may only contain lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (3–40 characters).
errors.platform_slug_reserved: The code «{slug}» is reserved by the platform; choose another.
errors.platform_locales_invalid: The default language must be one of the enabled languages.
errors.platform_time_zone_invalid: The time zone is not valid.
errors.platform_host_taken: This domain already belongs to a center.
errors.platform_host_reserved: Domains under {baseDomain} cannot be added; sub-domains there are center codes.
errors.platform_admin_email_invalid: The administrator email is not valid.
errors.platform_domain_primary: The default domain of a center cannot be removed.
errors.platform_domain_not_found: The center has no such domain.
errors.identity_bootstrap_invalid: The administrator details are not valid.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts: try again in a minute.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.unauthorized: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong ({code}). Please try again.
